verdict.rationale: Gide Loyrette Nouel is a law firm offering legal advisory services, not a software product that holds user data. Self-service export of all data in open formats is therefore a category error for this kind of product. Its GDPR advisory practice helps clients with their own compliance and is not a data-export feature of Gide itself, so the evidence does not make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
